picks.name: Mia Koden
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Ilian Tape. Connected to your Martinou pick -- also an Ilian Tape-affiliated producer.
picks.bio: "Decode Vol.2" (October 15, 2026, Ilian Tape) is the second EP from the former Sicaria Sound member for the Munich label, following 2023's "Decode" -- four tracks ("A-killa Rift," "Slink," "Earshotta," "Dread by Dawn") mining dark, moody dubstep and breaks, mastered by Tangible Air.
picks.why_listen: Heavy, grimy low-end with a breaks backbone -- functional, weighty material for a darker stretch of a set.
